descriptionHtml:
Meetion BTM007 Dual Mode Wireless Ergonomic Mouse Grey Edition (Dual Wireless Connection Bluetooth & 2.4GHz USB / Ergonomic Vertical Shape / Silent Mute Switches / Adjustable Optical Sensor / Built-in 700mAh Rechargeable Battery / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Reduce wrist fatigue and boost productivity with the Meetion BTM007 Dual Mode Wireless Ergonomic Mouse in stylish Grey Edition, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Engineeered with a natural vertical grip position to relieve strain during long working hours, this mouse features dual-mode wireless connectivity via Bluetooth and 2.4GHz USB receiver, ultra-quiet silent clicking switches, an adjustable DPI optical sensor, and a high-capacity built-in 700mAh rechargeable battery.
